card.title: Prove We’re Close
card.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send another 'fine,' tell me what you deleted. I want us to trust each other with the awkward version.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me be the person you can sound needy with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check whether you've replied before I get out of bed. Will you send me your needy bit now?

mechanism: A asks for an emotionally exposed message and responds to a reciprocity challenge by disclosing their own dependence.
confusable: Unlike extracting information, A must make vulnerable sharing a demonstration of trust in the connection.
comparison: D80-b offers personal disclosure before renewing the ask; D80-a offers naming the partnership before asking B to keep holding on.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
